<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><IMG src="c11678p1167801.jpg" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>





<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Vale proposes US$ 4&nbsp;billion for 2011 minimum dividend</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, January&nbsp;31, 2011 &#150; Vale S.A. (Vale) announces that its Executive Board has approved and will submit to
the Board of Directors a proposal for the distribution of a minimum dividend of US$ 4&nbsp;billion in 2011, equivalent to
US$ 0.766536226 per share for both common and preferred shares outstanding, to be distributed in two installments, on
April&nbsp;29 and October&nbsp;31, 2011.
</DIV>

<P align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt">The Board of Directors will evaluate the proposal submitted by senior management, regarding each installment, in the
meetings scheduled for April&nbsp;13 and October&nbsp;14, 2011.


<P align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt">If the proposal is approved by our Board of Directors, the payment of each installment will be made in Brazilian reais,
calculated on the basis of the Brazilian real/US dollar exchange rate (Ptax &#150; option 5) published by the Central Bank
of Brazil on the business day prior to the Board of Directors meeting that approves the dividend proposal.


<P align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt">The minimum dividend of US$ 4&nbsp;billion represents an increase of 60% compared to the minimum dividend announced in 2010.
Considering the extraordinary dividend of US$ 1&nbsp;billion being distributed today, the total minimum dividend in 2011
will be 66.7% higher than the amount distributed last year, US$ 3.0&nbsp;billion.


<P align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt">The proposed minimum dividend is consistent with Vale&#146;s financial policy, which aims to provide a strong support to the
exploitation of profitable growth opportunities alongside the preservation of a sound balance sheet.

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>For further information, please contact:</B><BR>
&#043;55-21-3814-4540<BR>
Roberto Castello Branco: roberto.castello.branco@vale.com<BR>
Viktor Moszkowicz: viktor.moszkowicz@vale.com<BR>
Carla Albano Miller: carla.albano@vale.com<BR>
Andrea Gutman: andrea.gutman@vale.com<BR>
Fernando Frey: fernando.frey@vale.com<BR>
Marcio Loures Penna: marcio.penna@vale.com<BR>
Samantha Pons: samantha.pons@vale.com<BR>
Thomaz Freire: thomaz.freire@vale.com
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">This press release may include declarations about Vale&#146;s expectations regarding future events or results. All
declarations based upon future expectations, rather than historical facts, are subject to various risks and
uncertainties. Vale cannot guarantee that such declarations will prove to be correct. These risks and uncertainties
include factors related to the following: (a)&nbsp;the countries where Vale operates, mainly Brazil and Canada; (b)&nbsp;the
global economy; (c)&nbsp;capital markets; (d)&nbsp;the mining and metals businesses and their dependence upon global industrial
production, which is cyclical by nature; and (e)&nbsp;the high degree of global competition in the markets in which Vale
operates. To obtain further information on factors that may give rise to results different from those forecast by Vale,
please consult the reports filed with the Brazilian Comiss&#227;o de Valores Mobili&#225;rios (CVM), the French Autorit&#233; des
March&#233;s Financiers (AMF), and with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), including Vale&#146;s most recent
Annual Report on Form&nbsp;20F and its reports on Form&nbsp;6K.
</DIV>
